mapper.sql: id, task_id, file_name, status, total_count, processed_count, success_count, update_count, fail_count, message, create_by, create_time, update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE phone_import_task SET status = #{status}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, update_count = #{updateCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, message = #{message}, update_time = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phone_import_task WHERE status = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE phone_import_task SET status = '2', message = CONCAT('导入任务中断：服务重启或执行超时（超过 ', #{minutes}, ' 分钟未更新）'), update_time = now() WHERE status = '0' AND update_time IS NOT NULL AND update_time < DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
